info.title: Record each change
info.text:
Follow statements in execution order.

Record a new value when a variable changes.

Keep outputs in their own column.

Challenge: What belongs in the output column?

10, because only print(x) produces output.

info.title: Use current values
info.text:
Use the most recently assigned value.

The right-hand side is evaluated first.

Then the new value replaces the old one.

Challenge: What is b after its final assignment?

8. The current value of a is 9, so b becomes 9 - 1.

info.title: Trace only the chosen branch
info.text:
Evaluate the condition using current values.

Follow only the branch selected.

Skipped assignments do not change variables.

Challenge: Which assignment is skipped?

y = 0 is skipped because x >= 5 is true.

info.title: Trace a running total
info.text:
Record each loop iteration.

Update the total using the current counter.

Output only where the algorithm says.

Challenge: What are the totals after iterations 1, 2 and 3?

1, 3 and 6. The output after the loop is 6.

info.title: Trace nested loops
info.text:
The inner loop restarts for each outer value.

Record counter values in separate columns.

Do not merge distinct output events.

Challenge: List the outputs in execution order.

2, 3, 3, 4.

info.title: Locate a fault with a trace
info.text:
Find the first unexpected value.

Link it to the statement that caused it.

Retest after making the correction.

Challenge: Which update produces totals 3, 7 and 12?

total = total + value, which accumulates instead of replacing the total.
